name: meow-memory
description: Hardened fork of Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory (0.31.1) for DeepSeek Harness: two-layer (user-scope + workspace) seven-layer SQLite memory with trust-gated stores, bounded injection/consolidation budgets, isolated auto-dream via spawn subagent, optional opt-in semantic embeddings + fuzzy hybrid retrieval, a visual user-scope global memory editor with next-turn reinjection, 0.2.x-compatible tools, and explicit memory management (memory_list/memory_forget).

fork.note: Hardened in this repository; not affiliated with upstream.
